Question Choices: What is the least common denominator of 1/x and 1/(x+2)?
Hints: The denominator factors are distinct.|Include each factor once.
Solution: Factor the polynomials: x and x + 2. Take every distinct factor at its greatest exponent to obtain x*(x + 2). It is divisible by each original polynomial with no unnecessary factors. When used as a common denominator, exclude all zeros of either original denominator.
